comment: The pool's fixed numbers, Prima.LocusPool, for the keeper, which cannot call it: apps/prima/test/prima/locus_pool_test.exs holds this file to the module value by value, and apps/locus/keeper/internal/admission/size_test.go holds the keeper's constants to it. floor_bytes is F, what the warm floor keeps from builds and programs, and floor_runners how many fresh runners it keeps. room_wait_ms is how long a start waits for room before it is refused, the close's own wait (Prima.LocusBackends.close_wait_ms). A place is charged at least its class's allowance_bytes from its place until allowance_ms after its spawn, and a place with no reading for stale_ms no less than its last charge. kinds gives each place's kind its class; a build's memory bound is cap_bytes, a runner's and a session's half of the pool's work, never under their least_cap_bytes (a runner's is its allowance and the components' hard ceiling, Prima.Limits.Ceiling's max_memory_bytes, together; a session's its allowance), and each class's processors are its spawns' bound.
